text:
maria-dev: Snyk/OSV just popped CVE-2025-23456 (json-fast <=1.2.3) on ingest-worker. Marked HIGH. Dependency chain: ingest-worker -> protobuf-adapter -> json-fast@1.2.3.

maria-dev: I believe this is a false positive for prod because we vendor a patched fork of json-fast in repo (see commit abc1234). The runtime binary we ship has patched code; the scanner flags the published npm package.

kevin: can you paste the package tree snippet + the shipped artifact sha256? need quick proof before we consider any exception.

maria-dev: copied below:
```
protobuf-adapter@2.4.1 -> json-fast@1.2.3
repo: github.com/redwood/ingest/tree/main/vendor/json-fast (patched)
shipped image: gcr.io/redwood/ingest-worker@sha256:fa3b6f1d9b6c8e5a2c4b7e1d9a8c6f4b2e1d3c4b5a6f7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6
vendor patch commit: abc1234
```

maria-dev: internal CI also runs static test that covers the parsing code (tests pass). But the external scanners still match semver of upstream package so alerts keep firing.

ethan: operationally we can rebuild images with the vendored code pinned and push, but that will take ~24–48h to roll through all regions. If security wants to avoid emergency rollback or mass churn, we can do a temporary allowlist on the scanner for prod only.

ethan: proposed constraints on the exception: allowlist only for production; 48h maximum; require immediate compensating controls: WAF rule to block suspicious payloads, Datadog monitor for increased parse errors, and enable audit logs on the ingest KMS key. Also rotate service account credentials after patch rollout.

kevin: +1 to the compensating controls; add requirement for an evidence bundle (artifact sha + vendor patch link + CI test run id). Without that we won't approve.

sara: as sec lead: I'm ok approving a short risk acceptance for prod only with strict conditions. Approve 48h exception (not 72h) provided the following are created and verified before we allowlist: 1) JIRA SEC-891 created and linked, 2) evidence bundle uploaded to the ticket, 3) Datadog monitor alert (team: ingest) set to severity P1 on parse error spike, 4) temporary WAF rule ID created (rule must be scoped to ingest-worker endpoints), 5) KMS audit logging enabled for key 'projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ingest/cryptoKeys/ingest-kms', 6) rotate the service principal creds after patch, 7) post-mortem + dependency update PR must be opened within the 48h window.

maria-dev: will do. I'll create SEC-891 now and attach the artifact + CI run. Owner: maria-dev. ETA for patch rollout: 36h.

sec-bot: Compliance exception entered: EXC-2025-42 (prod-only, 48h). Link: https://redwood.internal/vuln-exceptions/EXC-2025-42

maria-dev: done — SEC-891 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-891. Evidence bundle uploaded (build fa3b6f1d). WAF rule created: waf-3921 (scoped). Datadog monitor: ingest.parse-error.spike alerting. KMS audit enabled.

sara: thanks. enforcement: sec will revisit at expiration; if patch not merged we'll escalate to exec.

maria-dev: acknowledged, will keep thread updated and post the dependency PR when ready.
